body.label: Effect
body.html: Establish a Standard in your space or an adjacent empty space. Until your next turn, allies within 2 units gain +1 Defense.

surges.html: One affected ally gains +1 Defense until its next turn.

rider.title: STANDARD — AUTHORITY
rider.html: Spend this card's Authority while an ally is within 3 units of your Standard: 1–3 gain +1 Defense; 4–5 become Rallied; 6+ become Rallied and remove Dazed, Concussed, or Shocked.
rider.meta: STORE ONE ROLLED RESULT; THAT RESULT IS REMOVED FROM THIS ACTION
